overview_description.description:
CloudHealth Technologies is changing the way organizations manage cloud environments. The company's cloud management platform aggregates, correlates, and analyzes data from disparate cloud data sets so that enterprises and service providers can align cloud operations with business objectives, reduce costs and ensure service levels are being met, based on an optimally performing cloud environment.

The company is backed by 406 Ventures and Sigma Prime Ventures. It was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Boston, MA. For more information.

about_short_description.short_description: CloudHealth Technologies delivers cloud service management for enterprises to effectively optimize cost, usage, performance, and security.

product.name: Cloud Financial Management
product.description: Continuously analyze consumption trends, drive accountability against budgets, and find opportunities to optimize your cloud spend.

product.name: Cloud Operations
product.description: Automate daily cloud operations, speed decision making, and reduce risk.

product.name: AWS Management
product.description: Manage your entire AWS environment as you scale while empowering users across the organization to optimize costs and resources and drive operational efficiencies.

product.name: Azure Management
product.description: Simplify financial management, find ways to optimize your Azure bill, and streamline workflows with custom policies.

product.name: GCP Management
product.description: Manage your entire GCP environment with visibility into resource usage and costs and underutilized resource reclamation.

product.name: OCI Management
product.description: Gain visibility into your OCI cost and usage, make more informed resource planning and budget forecasting decisions, and hold business units and projects accountable.
